name: The Monster Surfaces
summary: Argo Brinewhistle wants you to use a ball of bait to lure a sea monster from the waters near the murloc islands. He asks you to bring its head back for the boat.

sections.title: Wreckage in the Water
sections.body: Argo Brinewhistle points you toward the murloc islands, where you found a drawing. There, fresh wreckage marks the water where the bait should be thrown. The sea monster is the danger Argo wants drawn out, and its head is meant for the boat.

faq.q: What does Argo want me to do?
faq.answer: Argo wants you to use the Big Ball o' Bait near fresh wreckage in the water by the murloc islands, then bring the monster's head to him.

faq.q: Where do I throw the bait?
faq.answer: Argo points you to fresh wreckage in the water near the murloc islands, where you found a drawing.

faq.q: Why does Argo want the monster's head?
faq.answer: Argo wants to make a decoration of the creature's head for the boat.
It is called the Big Ball o' Bait.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Monster Surfaces
